excerpt.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了[target.GetName]的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
excerpt.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the [target.GetName]'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.
